text: The top bar was running. We let it run.
The bottom one waited. It wasn't done.
A little bot. Late. And right on time.
There's a third one now. It doesn't race.
It sits by the note and it holds the pace.
The room was two. The bot came through.
The bot just watches the window go wide.
It keeps the page open while the lanes fly by.
Same desk, same light, just a slower pace.
Call if you're late. The bot can wait.
